verdict.rationale: ByteAsk ships an `auto` model setting that chains three models across two providers instead of one fixed choice. As described, though, it is a reliability failover (a turn moves to the next model if one is having a bad day), not routing that picks the best model for each task. Missing for 10: evidence of task-aware model selection or routing criteria, first-party docs beyond a single changelog line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
